'''Chros-filik''', a [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phu/Legends|Phu]], took part in a race held at the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Hunted" /> A famous<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Podracing/Legends|Podracer]], Chros-filik was among names of the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|competitors']] neophyte [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] could recognize as an appreciator of the sport. The winner of the race had been predetermined by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Hunted" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chros-filik first appeared on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] in the [[2003]] young reader novel ''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]'' by [[Elizabeth Hand]].<ref name="Hunted" />
